resources.name: Arduino Uno Rev3 Microcontroller Board
resources.description: Standard ATmega328P microcontroller board with 14 digital I/O pins, 6 analog inputs, 16 MHz quartz crystal, and USB connection. Ideal for prototyping sensors and actuators.
resources.location_description: Cabinet A2, Shelf 1, NIT Electronics Lab

resources.name: ESP-32 NodeMCU Wi-Fi & Dual-Mode Bluetooth Board
resources.description: Powerful dual-core 240MHz SoC with integrated 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi and Bluetooth v4.2 BR/EDR and BLE. Essential for connected IoT sensor nodes and edge computing.

resources.name: DHT11 Temperature & Humidity Sensor Module
resources.description: Calibrated digital signal output temperature and humidity composite sensor. Features resistive-type humidity measurement component and NTC temperature measurement component.
resources.location_description: Component Box S-14, NIT Electronics Lab

resources.name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B (4GB RAM) Starter Kit
resources.description: Quad-core 64-bit ARM Cortex-A72 at 1.5GHz, dual 4K micro-HDMI, Gigabit Ethernet, 2x USB 3.0, 2x USB 2.0. Supplied with 32GB microSD and official power supply.
resources.location_description: Locker B-3, Embedded Systems Lab, NIT

resources.name: Rigol DS1054Z 50MHz 4-Channel Digital Oscilloscope
resources.description: Four-channel 50MHz digital storage oscilloscope with 1GSa/s real-time sampling rate, 24Mpts deep memory, and 30,000 wfms/s capture rate. Requires verified Oscilloscope training.
resources.location_description: Precision Bench 1, Test & Measurement Lab, NIT

resources.name: 4WD Smart Robot Car Chassis Kit with L298N Driver
resources.description: Complete 4-wheel drive acrylic chassis kit with 4 DC gear motors, encoder wheels, battery holder, ultrasonic sensor mount, and L298N dual H-bridge motor driver module.

resources.name: Fluke 101 Pocket Digital Multimeter with Probes
resources.description: Compact basic true-RMS accurate digital multimeter measuring AC/DC voltage, resistance, capacitance, frequency, and continuity. CAT III 600V safety rated.
resources.location_description: Cabinet M, Tool Station 3, Greenfield GEC

bookings.purpose: Autonomous obstacle avoidance robot for Semester 5 Embedded Systems mini-project.
IoT smart weather station sending MQTT telemetry to AWS IoT Core.
Computer vision edge inference node with OpenCV and MobileNet v2.
Greenhouse climate monitoring proof of concept experiment.
High voltage capacitor charging circuit testing.

condition_reports.notes: Tested HDMI output and USB ports. All working normally. Included SanDisk 32GB SD card and official power adaptor.
Returned in original static protective pouch. Pins straight and fully operational.
Red positive test lead banana plug terminal sheath cracked during use.
Handover completed via Lab Head QR verification and receiver scan.

incidents.description: Red test lead wire sheath pulled loose from banana plug jack. Multimeter main body intact and calibration accurate.
incidents.resolution_notes: Lead probe replacement estimated at INR 350. Discussed with borrower; partial deposit deduction under review.
